question: Where can I find café inside 80 kilometers while progressing from the David C. Driskell Center, College Park, MD toward Montrose Woods Park, Rockville, MD?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-76.946127 38.987852)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-77.135257 39.056776)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'cafe'
AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-76.946127 38.987852)',4326)::geography, 80000)
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-76.946127 38.987852)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5);

[3].display_name: The David C. Driskell Center, College Park, MD
